other_static_semantics: Pending capture precedes dispatch, raw envelope persistence precedes UTF-8/schema/Unicode/truncation interpretation, terminal persistence precedes follow-up, immutable chain and full-selected-denominator353 audit, unknown coverage/null billing, same-FD file checks/exclusive creation/fsync/readback/close-once/no-unlink and read-only no-resubmit recovery match source and documented cooperative/trusted-runtime limits. No extra blocking finding in those scoped paths.

finding.basis: Independent frozen-source analysis only; no project import, test, CLI, transport or mutation probe
finding.consequence: prepare accepts this plan. After pending512 is acknowledged, existing audit/source/file guards run and boundedCall invokes the fixture. A returned bounded raw envelope then needs raw513, but Journal.emit refuses before writing it because frames.length>=512. Known finite capacity can therefore cause an avoidable dispatch with no retained returned raw bytes; the operation becomes uncertain and recovery retains pending/unknown state. No execution or billing claim is made.
finding.requested_change: Reject demonstrably oversized finite plans before filesystem effects or dispatch, or reserve the mandatory remaining raw/terminal/item/final events before each dispatch and stop explicitly without sending work that cannot be captured. Add a regression for this allowed maximum retry plan and prove zero fixture calls/unchanged empty directory on admission refusal, or prove reserved termination captures on the alternative design.
finding.other_budgets: 32MiB capture/8MiB ledger caps remain separate; this finding establishes the discrete event-cap failure without assuming response size, synchronous timing, provider behavior or a runtime measurement.

author_remote_38_claim: Reported separately by author; not a reviewer runtime pass. Own exact CI extension remains separate.
